message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 75.3% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in data engineering and testing. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 3200 per year. I live in Kolkata. I'm open to going abroad. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in data engineering and testing

explanation:
This German MCA program is highly recommended because it offers a strong career focus (data science/software engineering) and provides an excellent post-study work visa of 18 months. The tuition cost ($2050) also fits within your family's budget.

This German MCA program is an excellent option for maximizing job prospects. It has a high median starting salary ($34339) and offers the same valuable 18-month post-study work visa, making it ideal for your goal of securing a good job after graduation.

If you prefer staying in India but want to focus on data engineering, this MTech program is suitable. While the tuition ($3900) exceeds your budget, its strong placement rate (81%) and relevant field make it a good career-focused choice.

This MSc Data Science program in Kolkata aligns with your interest in data engineering. It is affordable ($3550) and keeps you close to home while providing a relevant degree path.

This MTech Computer Science program in Bengaluru focuses on data analytics and software engineering. It is very affordable ($500) and provides a good balance of low cost with relevant technical training.
